author: Leila Gharani
description:
Microsoft just added the "Center Across Selection" button directly to the Excel ribbon! Stop using Merge & Center. It breaks your formulas and messes up your data sorting. 

Now you can get the exact same look while keeping your spreadsheets perfectly functional.  What bad data habit do you wish your coworkers would stop doing? Let me know in the comments!
